text: Through our Lord Jesus Christ, your Son, who lives and reigns with you in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God, for all ages of ages.
attribution: Original Triptych study rendering of the separately identified public-domain Latin conclusion. It is not Lasance/Walsh English and is not an approved liturgical translation.

latin_source.selection: The full contiguous long Father-through-Son conclusion, excluding the separately marked response.

scope: Fixed study conclusion expression only; no petition, response, calendar appointment or execution authority is supplied by this artifact.
